description: Code-behind file for the 'TakenCourses' ASP.NET page, handling navigation button clicks to transfer users to different pages within the Online Examination System.

classes.name: TakenCourses
classes.description: ASP.NET page class handling user navigation among different pages via button clicks.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the 'home' button is clicked; transfers user to Dashboard.aspx.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the 'profile' button is clicked; transfers user to UserProfile.aspx.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the 'leaderboard' button is clicked; transfers user to Leaderboard.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the 'logout' button is clicked; transfers user to LoginPage.aspx.
